tasks.short: Enforce passenger-attendant safety rules in live operations

steps.what: Check the applicable safety rule and operating instruction
Observe passenger-attendant operations for safety compliance
Enforce rules through immediate instruction and safe intervention

tasks.design: Configure a native link from the duty context to the current safety instruction in {DOCS}. Only repeated document navigation shrinks; the supervisor still observes and enforces safety directly.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current operating instruction requires repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links can expose the released instruction without generating safety advice.
tasks.still_hard: Immediate hazards and human responses demand situational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor notices unsafe practice and intervenes appropriately.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a native document link can shorten safety-instruction retrieval, while observation and enforcement stay human.

assumptions: Boundary is routine live enforcement rather than a reportable incident investigation. It includes reference lookup, observation and intervention. No new enforcement log is proposed; where an actual occurrence requires an incident record, written escalation or separate send, add those real steps before using this graph for that occurrence.

The safety owner already publishes instruction identifier, revision and operating category. s1 checks currency, reads the rule and manually finds missing references; no new capture or automatic interpretation is assumed.

Native links first. One point of s1 navigation disappears; nine points of reading, checking and fallback remain. No physical enforcement, conversation or existing system runtime saving is claimed. Shares are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Frequency and ownership of mandatory occurrence records
research_questions: Does a duty-context link reliably open the current instruction?
Observe routine and reportable occurrences separately

already_counted.description: Read current rules, verify revisions and manually find missing references.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes one navigation point less 0.3 upkeep. Conservative newly revised procedure needs manual source tracing, leaving only 0.4 point of direct-link navigation removable: 0.1 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train attendants in operational procedures and company policies

steps.what: Select current operational procedures and policy teaching content
Prepare the existing procedure training slides and examples
Check procedure meaning and prepare teaching equipment
Demonstrate operational functions and explain company policies
Observe attendant practice and correct operational misunderstandings

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} slide layouts for the training materials this supervisor already prepares. The supervisor retains technical content, examples, complete procedure checking, demonstrations and coaching; no model generates operating rules.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated headings and slide arrangement interrupt teaching preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native layout can reuse the existing training structure.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding and safely performing procedures require live explanation and correction.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises unsafe misunderstanding during practice.
tasks.altitude: Teaching authority stays unchanged; layout consumes less preparation time.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document layouts can reduce repeated slide arrangement without replacing operational instruction.

assumptions: Boundary is a practical training session already using supervisor-prepared slides. If current training uses no such material, remove and reweight the preparation shares rather than inventing a slide baseline.

s1 produces procedure revision, selected policy passages, teaching objectives and examples. The procedure/policy owners already maintain the source material. Missing guidance is manually clarified in retained s1-s3 time; no new source capture is free.

Try native layouts first. Three points of repeated headings/arrangement disappear from s2; seven remain for original examples, images, compatibility repair and ordinary ungated saving. s3 keeps all technical meaning checks and physical teaching setup; extra repair reduces the estimate.

This graph establishes no formal competence certificate or attendance record. Add any actual required completion entry, certificate release or separate dispatch as its own work rather than adding a record nobody reads. All live teaching time remains retained and shares are model estimates.
unknowns: Actual slide preparation and reusable layout content
Required training completion records, if any
research_questions: Does the native layout preserve procedure warnings and version references?
Measure layout separately from original example preparation

already_counted.description: Original examples, image/layout repair, complete procedure checks and setup.

incremental.description: Maintain layouts as procedure and policy presentation requirements change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes three specific layout points less 0.6 upkeep. Conservative new operating procedure needs new illustrations and custom warnings, leaving only one point of recurring slide headings reusable: 0.4 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify service volumes, duty periods and staffing standard inputs
Choose demand assumptions and exceptional service coverage
Compute personnel requirements from explicit service and coverage rules
Check staffing calculations and revise unsupported cases

tasks.design: Configure native {SPREADSHEET} formulas for the personnel-requirement branch of this task. The supervisor supplies and checks demand and coverage assumptions; the calculation estimates aggregate staffing without assigning or scoring individual workers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected coverage assumptions are repeatedly multiplied and totalled by period.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed formulas can apply explicit staffing ratios and duty coverage rules.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain demand and unusual accessibility or disruption needs require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises when a nominal staffing ratio is inadequate for safe service.
tasks.altitude: Staffing assumptions and resource decisions stay with the supervisor.

evidence.claim: Quinyx supports logistics workforce forecasting and scheduling; this is capability context, not measured passenger-attendant savings.

assumptions: The statement permits cash, payroll, transportation or personnel estimates; this graph covers aggregate personnel requirements only. It does not compute wages, move money, publish a roster or allocate named workers. Other estimate types need their own inputs and weights.

Service operations already supplies departure/duty periods and demand estimates; workforce policy owners supply minimum coverage, shift duration and permitted buffer rules. s1 includes checking, manual entry and missing-field research; s2 explicitly decides demand scenarios and exceptional coverage. No hidden producer or model inference supplies assumptions.

Test existing workforce forecasting or native spreadsheet formulas before code. s3 removes explicit multiplication, rounding and period totals only. s4 retains full checks, manually calculated unsupported service cases and ordinary saving; excess repair lowers the estimate. Existing system runtime is not labour.
All shares are model estimates. No external send or employment decision is implied by a draft staffing estimate.
unknowns: Current manual arithmetic effort and available forecasting features
research_questions: Do formulas preserve minimum coverage and rounding by duty period?
Test a new service with no comparable demand history

already_counted.description: Verify/capture inputs, decide assumptions and check or repair complete staffing estimates.

incremental.description: Maintain staffing-rule formulas and test changed service patterns.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 30 arithmetic points less two upkeep. Conservative new service has uncertain demand and bespoke coverage, leaving only six points of standard duration/ratio arithmetic reusable: four net. No assumption-setting time disappears.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend and implement a passenger-service work-method improvement

steps.what: Review passenger feedback and existing operational observations
Discuss current work-method barriers with attendants
Recommend and choose an authorised service-handover improvement
Write the existing service-handover instruction revision

loop.output: Draft revision with unchanged requirements preserved
loop.check: Supervisor checks source alignment, omitted duties, misleading promises and whether any unauthorised change was introduced
loop.stop: Missing authority or two failed revisions returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use the fixed instruction format first; variable procedural wording remains

steps.what: Check final instruction, implementation scope and attendant recipients
Send the approved revised instruction to attendants
Implement the work-method change through live coaching and observation

tasks.design: For an existing service-handover improvement, use the native instruction format in {DOCS} before a bounded loop phrases the supervisor's decided revision. The supervisor checks the complete instruction and recipients, retains the separate {EMAIL} send, and implements the change personally through coaching.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing a clear revision takes time after the operational choice is made.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-bound loop can assist wording without choosing the change.
tasks.still_hard: Motivation, practical barriers and sustained adoption require participation and observation.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor builds staff understanding and adjusts the change when it fails in practice.
tasks.altitude: The supervisor keeps improvement decisions and implementation responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound drafting can phrase a decided instruction change while work-method judgement and implementation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is one service-handover work-method improvement already requiring an actual instruction revision and staff send, within this supervisor's existing authority. It does not generalise to motivational pay decisions or safety-policy amendments; those need their actual decision-makers and approvals.

s1 verifies existing feedback and observations; s2 obtains staff context without recording new surveillance data. s3 supplies the decided change, scope, unchanged duties and existing instruction revision. Missing facts or authority are resolved manually in retained s1-s5 time, not inferred or transferred free.

Native instruction formatting first. Only three points of wording disappear from s4; 12 remain for drafting/source checks and repair, plus nine in s5 for complete instruction/recipient checking. Extra repair reduces the estimate. Ordinary author saving remains fully retained and ungated.

s6 is the real staff instruction send and is separately gated after the final revision exists. Its one point stays fully retained. Any wording, scope or recipient edit voids approval. s7 retains all live implementation time; no new implementation log is invented.
Shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Which improvement types require an actual written instruction
research_questions: Does the draft preserve all unchanged operational duties?
Observe implementation feedback without substituting individual performance scoring

already_counted.description: Draft/source checking, manual wording repairs and complete final instruction/recipient review.

incremental.description: Maintain revision prompts and check source-to-instruction alignment after format changes.

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final revised instruction, scope and attendant recipient list; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes three wording points less one upkeep. Conservative first trial needs substantial novel explanation and staff-sensitive wording; only 1.2 points of already-decided neutral wording are reusable, leaving 0.2 net. Send and implementation remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A supervisor who retains safety enforcement, training and improvement implementation, with targeted reductions in retrieval, layout, staffing arithmetic and wording.
skills_to_grow: Validate staffing assumptions and minimum coverage
Check procedure wording against released instructions
Distinguish aggregate forecasting from individual worker evaluation
role.ambitious_version: Protect direct supervision and staff coaching while reducing specific repeated preparation operations.
